summary: The requested arithmetic prototype is validated. All eight packed-K controls pass (B1/B4 prefill/decode, two-head and Granite 32Q/8KV GQA). Native integration remains blocked: current QFP8CH KV-cache packing cannot directly feed QFP8WT FP8 matmul. Production cache writes and DL16 reads pass at B1/B4. Separate DL16 expansion and QFP8WT repacking allow FP8 QK at both B1/B4, but retain expansion cost and add repacking. No end-to-end model or speedup claim.
cluster: production cache GQA B1 prefill (gather+FP8 QK)
production cache GQA B4 prefill (gather+FP8 QK)
hypotheses: H1
Dynamic per-row Q scales or FP8 arithmetic unsupported
ruled out
All four B1/B4 prefill/decode QFP8WT controls pass; compiled batchmatmulfp8 confirmed.
H2
Current QFP8CH K packing incompatible with transposed FP8 matmul
confirmed
B1 prefill fails: batchmatmulfp8 cannot restickify input y.
H3
The mismatch depends on batch size or query length
ruled out
All four QFP8CH cases fail; all four QFP8WT controls pass.
H4
DL16 dequantization then weight repacking bridges the formats
confirmed
Separate DL16 expansion, then QFP8WT packing works for B1/B4 prefill; attention relative L2 1.373% / 1.296%. Fusing the bridge fails.
H5
Existing FP8 copy can directly repack QFP8CH to QFP8WT
ruled out
copy_ into QFP8WT fails: no mechanism to resolve stick incompatibility.
H6
Real head-major store/read has the same limitation
confirmed
Production QFP8CH store and DL16 readback pass at B1/B4. Native gather+FP8 QK fails both with unsupported stick expressions (64 versus 128 elements).
H7
Granite GQA can fold groups into the query-row axis
confirmed
All four Granite-shaped GQA QFP8WT controls pass (B1/B4, prefill/decode). Folding groups into Q rows works.
H8
Standalone minimal torch-spyre repro shows same compiler error
confirmed
Minimal repro.py reproduces same batchmatmulfp8 error without vLLM/inference.

experiments.outcome: Confirmed minimal compiler reproduction; see repro.log.

next_actions: For direct cached FP8 QK, implement a real QFP8CH→QFP8WT repack or a QFP8WT K-cache/store/gather path. Quantize Q once outside the page walk. A fresh-prefill fast path can pack the DL16 K projection directly, as the positive controls do. Model accuracy and performance evaluation must follow integration. The source prototype is retained as explicitly requested; no external issue/PR was opened.
